name: @pemo/qr-pass-demo-store
description: In-memory demo of the Shared QR Pass Service v0 (VISITOR_ACCESS only): COSE_Sign1/CWT + base45 passes signed with an in-memory Ed25519 key, online use consume, revocation list, demo outbox. Pure TS on node:crypto, no deps, no pg.

scripts.test: pnpm run build && node --test dist/base45.test.js dist/cbor.test.js dist/store.test.js
